# polaris_principal (Resource)

Manage a Polaris principal. Objects are never silently adopted; import existing names before applying.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "polaris_principal" "user" {
  name                         = "existing-entra-object-id"
  properties                   = { identity_type = "user" }
  credential_rotation_required = true
  lifecycle { ignore_changes = [credential_rotation_required] }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Stable Polaris object name.

### Optional

- `credential_rotation_required` (Boolean) Creation-only credential rotation marker; enforcement depends on server settings.
- `properties` (Map of String) String properties owned by this resource.

### Read-Only

- `client_id` (String) Generated client ID. The generated secret is discarded and never enters state.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import polaris_principal.user 'existing-entra-object-id'
```
